prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final fantasy RPG inventory icon for Cosmic Rune. Authored description: A yellow rune ringed with a wheel of stars. It spreads an invocation across an area. Every area invocation spends one beside its rank rune. Subject: A thick golden-yellow mineral rune stone bearing deeply carved circular wheel with six large star-shaped marks around its rim, dark recesses and restrained warm gold light. Render as a polished realistic 3D fantasy collectible with convincing tactile material, soft studio key light from upper left, restrained highlights, clean silhouette. Near-front three-quarter view reveals thickness and dimensionality. Single centered object occupies 80 percent of square 1024px canvas with safe margins, extremely clear at 48px. Genuine transparent alpha background with no environment, no floor, no cast shadow outside object, no labels, no text, no border, no tile, no watermark. Do not make a flat vector, generic gem, or diagram.
sourceLookup: Source model audit inspected loose rune and orb candidates. Available essence nodes and altars are world structures, not carriable rune stones or singleton boss cores. No suitable loose rune/orb GLB exists. Authored item descriptions from game/src/content/items.ts and equipment.ts and existing runeIcons.ts motifs informed generated art.
